import re
import sys

text = sys.stdin.read()
values = {}

instruction = re.compile(
    r"\b(?P<var>a|b|c|d|e|f|g|h|TMP)\s*<-\s*"
    r"(?:\(\s*(?P=var)\s*\+\s*(?P<delta>\d+)\s*\)\s*mod\s*100"
    r"|(?P<literal>\d+))"
)

for match in instruction.finditer(text):
    name = match.group("var")
    if match.group("literal") is not None:
        values[name] = int(match.group("literal"))
    else:
        values[name] = (values[name] + int(match.group("delta"))) % 100

names = ("a", "b", "c", "d", "e", "f", "g", "h", "TMP")
print("; ".join(f"{name} ?= {values[name]}" for name in names) + ";")
